product_metadata.title: OXO Good Grips Complete Grate & Slice Set - NEW
features: Set includes: coarse and medium grating surfaces, straight and julienne slicing surfaces and food holder
Protective food holder keeps fingers safe while you slice
Lid features Cup and Milliliter markings so you can measure as you work
Color-coded surfaces can be used over bowls or plates for quick jobs
Non-slip feet and handle for secure, comfortable grip
Compact storage with slots for each surface and food holder
For best results, use the food holder with slicing surfaces only
description: Grate, slice, julienne and measure—all with the OXO Good Grips Complete Grate & Slice Set. Our compact and convenient Set includes four color-coded surfaces—coarse grating, medium grating, straight slicing and julienne slicing—as well as a food holder that keeps your fingers safe. The Set’s lid features Cup and Milliliter markings (up to 2 cups/500 mL) so you can measure as you work. The surfaces nest in the lid during use or can be held comfortably to work directly over bowls and plates. The non-slip handle and feet provide comfortable, skid-free grating and slicing. Each surface fits neatly into a slot in the base alongside the food holder for smart storage. Top-rack dishwasher safe.
